svg.aria-label: From a route on envoy-external to a proxied record: 1. Token: ExternalSecret cloudflare-dns builds the API token and zone ID for Secret cloudflare-dns-secret from 1Password item cloudflare. 2. Watch: The external-dns controller reads HTTPRoutes attached to envoy-external and DNSEndpoint objects on a one minute interval. 3. Write: It writes proxied records in the lab zone, each with a TXT twin that marks ownership. 4. Prune: Policy sync deletes the records it owns when their source goes away. Records without a twin are never touched.
